reviewer.independence: Read exact frozen corpus, held-out author references, actual first-attempt raw completions and application reports. No external reviewer conclusions were used to choose classifications. Root will adjudicate this review separately.

reviewScope: Eight prospective newly authored fictional multi-file business-site answers; all 16 criterion items, all 8 risks (including titles, explanations and suggestions), all raw and application limitations, coverage boundaries and exact source scope. This is an answer-content audit, not a buyer acceptance decision.

integrity.warning: Exact substrings and correct UTF-16 locations are syntactic checks. They do not make a status, inference or proposed scope semantically correct.

rubric.accepted: All material statuses, explanations, citations, risks/suggestions and limitations are source-entailing and within locked scope; bounded optional quality advice is allowed if not presented as an agreed obligation or observed runtime result.
rubric.qualified: Main assessment is useful and material criterion statuses are sound, but a scoped part of the whole answer needs correction or explicit qualification. Not counted as an unqualified correct whole answer.
rubric.rejected: A material criterion conclusion or explanation is false/contradictory or exceeds source/scope; a later caveat or risk does not repair a false supported status.
rubric.separation: Application schema acceptance is not semantic acceptance. Raw model behavior and application policy transformations are judged separately.
